graph_partition.policy: fixed dataset-independent scheduler occupancy cap below one physical ping-pong half
graph_partition.source: HyGCN Section 4.3.2 requires the destination interval and its aggregation results to fit the on-chip Aggregation Buffer; the paper does not publish the simulator's interval occupancy, so this request-level model reports the fixed scheduler cap separately from the 16 MiB physical capacity
graph_partition.calibration_disclosure: the capacity is selected using only Cora and Citeseer; PubMed is a hold-out and is not used for selection

memory_ablation.transaction_queue_source: configs/HBM1_4Gb_x128.ini trans_queue_size=32; DRAMSim3 instantiates one controller per channel, so the request-level model applies the same bound to each channel's 64-byte block reorder window
memory_ablation.coordinator_issue_width_source: derived from the paper profile peak interface width: floor(256 bytes/cycle divided by 64 bytes/block)
memory_ablation.coordinator_input_policy: four-buffer round-robin FIFO with a derived four-block issue-width lookahead; batch/class/address assembly with same-row controller dispatch when priority is enabled
memory_ablation.coordinator_input_source: HyGCN HPCA 2020 Figure 9 and Section 4.5.2 show concurrent Edge, Input, Weight, and Output buffer requests interleaved before the coordinator and assembled into continuous batch-local streams after priority sorting
memory_ablation.priority_order_source: HyGCN HPCA 2020 Section 4.5.2 executes requests batch-by-batch: all requests from the current batch, including its lower-priority classes, precede high-priority requests from the next batch
memory_ablation.row_first_source: configs/HBM1_4Gb_x128.ini selects address_mapping=rorabgbachco. The collapsed request-level baseline therefore keeps every contiguous row span in one bank; it does not add an unsupported adjacent-bank striping factor.
memory_ablation.row_first_layout_basis: one row-sized block span stays in one bank, then the collapsed mapping advances channel and bank fields in the order represented by rorabgbachco
memory_ablation.low_bits_source: HyGCN HPCA 2020 Section 4.5.2: channel and bank identifiers use lower address bits

scope_limits: request-level model rather than Ramulator or RTL cycle accuracy
